name: JobTread
description: JobTread lets agents read and update jobs, budgets, daily logs, tasks, and documents in the signed-in JobTread organization. Each user signs in to their own JobTread account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my active jobs and their current status.
Compare the budget and actual costs for the Smith kitchen remodel.
Draft today's daily log for the Main Street job from these notes.

apps.name: JobTread
apps.description: Jobs, budgets, daily logs, and tasks, over JobTread's MCP server with browser sign-in.
